answer: An AI-agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock collateral in an escrow vault linked across networks by an identity bridge. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of committing illiquid capital per identity, making synthetic swarms unaffordable even if deployed for simple workloads like composing a sonnet. However, this economic threshold excludes resource-constrained developers and does not stop adversaries with vast financial reserves.
